EDITORIAL_OUTLINE: Separate passenger WAV, transfer-seat and drive-from-chair needs
Identify the converter and exact completed conversion
Measure the occupied-chair route, doorway and travelling space
Ask a specialist to confirm chair and occupant restraint compatibility
Demonstrate ramp/lift with the intended user and assistance
Request conversion records, maintenance history and local service support
Hold purchase until fit and unresolved conversion questions are settled
EDITORIAL_RECOMMENDATION_BOUNDARY: Buyer evidence requests and decision gates are editorial recommendations, not claims of AutoBridge operations or statutory requirements.
